svg.title: Contribution activity as an oscilloscope trace
svg.desc: Oscilloscope-style trace of weekly GitHub contributions over the last year (square-root scale). 1231 contributions, 184 active days out of 371, longest streak 67 days, current streak 67 days, peak day 120 on 2026-09-11, mean 23.2 per week.
svg.text: src: github contribution calendar · redrawn daily by actions
